rationale: EO 11943 only corrects one printed figure in Schedule 3 of EO 11941. That command was spent when the order issued on 1976-10-25, and the corrected figure lived inside EO 11941 until section 4 of EO 12010 (September 28, 1977) superseded EO 11941. The Federal Register catalog observation and the 1989 codification observation both record the amendment of EO 11941 and its supersession by EO 12010, and the held Federal Register text of EO 12010 confirms it. No held source shows a later revival, so the order is not in force on 2026-10-14.
